name: MEGA sign-in
description: Signs a MEGA account in without the password ever entering the sandbox.

codes.mega_auth.account_version_unsupported: This MEGA account still uses the legacy key derivation
codes.mega_auth.bad_reply: MEGA answered the sign-in with something that could not be read
codes.mega_auth.credentials_rejected: MEGA refused this address and password
codes.mega_auth.multi_factor_required: This MEGA account asks for a second factor, which is not supported yet
codes.mega_auth.nothing_to_poll: A MEGA sign-in finishes in one step; start it again
codes.mega_auth.rate_limited: MEGA is rate limiting sign-in attempts from this address
codes.mega_auth.session_unreadable: MEGA's session could not be opened with this account's key
codes.mega_auth.unavailable: MEGA is temporarily not answering sign-in requests
